title: Diverse, but Divisive: LLMs Can Exaggerate Gender Differences in Opinion Related to Harms of Misinformation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses generated from gender-conditioned and gender-neutral prompts against human annotations from men and women using z-score standardized Likert scale ratings. The study uses bootstrapping and Mean Squared Error (MSE) to measure whether LLMs exaggerate gender-based differences in opinion and whether neutrally-prompted LLMs align more closely with a specific gender's viewpoint.
